addresses_owner_chk.name: addresses_owner_chk
addresses_owner_chk.value: ("addresses"."user_id" is not null) <> ("addresses"."org_id" is not null)

price_lists_validity_chk.name: price_lists_validity_chk
price_lists_validity_chk.value: "price_lists"."valid_to" is null or "price_lists"."valid_from" is null or "price_lists"."valid_to" > "price_lists"."valid_from"

approval_policies_range_chk.name: approval_policies_range_chk
approval_policies_range_chk.value: "approval_policies"."min_amount" is null or "approval_policies"."max_amount" is null or "approval_policies"."max_amount" >= "approval_policies"."min_amount"
